name: Picsart
description: Picsart offers creative APIs to boost artistic expression on multiple platforms. Our tools unleash creativity, empowering users to experiment with imagination.

events.d: Changes the background of an image.
The Upscale module uses AI to boost resolution and increase the quality of your images.
Automatically remove the image backdrop and cut out the main subject with a clean, transparent background.
Ultra Upscale uses predictive AI to boost resolution, upscale images with noise suppression, and enhance low-res photos, stickers, and geometric shapes.
Ultra Enhance is an advanced upscaling technique powered by a generative AI model that boosts resolution and adds high-frequency detail.
